title: Raftel
tagline: We are building a simple crypto payroll management solution for first time founders who raised money through crypto
description: This project is primarily aimed at individuals or startups who manage a nimble team and have raised their first funding in crypto and want to disburse their team's salaries using crypto. The organization admin can add a preferred currency that the employee chooses and disburse the salaries in that token itself
how_its_made: We are using ThreadDB for all data storage and using uniswap for token conversion to pay the team member in their preferred currency. Web3js is used for wallet connection. Superfluid is used to setup a streaming payroll processing for certain employees. Frontend is built using vuejs and deployed in vercel
